entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thanks for holding. You're speaking with Alex at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I please get your name and order number to pull up your account?

Thank you, Sarah. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor, delivered on December 15th. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
It was just a bad time. There was an emergency.
I'm sorry to hear that. Could you elaborate a bit for me? Depending on the circumstances, we may have some options.
It was a whole thing. My husband's military deployment got moved up suddenly, and right after he left I had to go to the hospital for an unexpected surgery. So, no, I didn't get to try your band.
Oh my, that's a lot to deal with. I'm very sorry you went through that. Please give me just one moment to check the return eligibility on your order.

Okay, thanks for your patience, Sarah. Actually, good news. I don't even need to process a special exception. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, and since your order was delivered 32 days ago, you are well within the window.
Oh. So I didn't need to explain all that?

Well, it's good for us to know, but in this case the standard policy covers it. I have just approved the return and emailed a prepaid shipping label to you. Once we receive the item, you'll see a full refund within 3 to 5 business days.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope things get easier for you soon. Have a good rest of your day.
